results.title: Invite a friend by email
results.checks: Signed in as Seed Reader, Add a friend with an email address reads Send invitation; sending says 'Invitation sent to …' with no Home window, and Sent requests shows the address as Invited by email with Resend and Cancel; Resend says it was sent again; Cancel takes it off. (The invitation calls are answered by the test, so no email goes out; each carries the reader's sign-in)
results.note: 'flow-210334@example.org': Invitation sent; listed as Invited by email; Resend said sent again; Cancel took it off; no Home window

results.title: An emailed invitation opens in the reader
results.checks: The link /invite/<token> opens a welcome: 'Ruth invited you to Seed Bible' with Ruth's note, the terms and one Continue (it asks for the terms first); a dead link says 'This invitation can't be opened'; signed in, 'Welcome' and Add Ruth as a friend takes the invitation (the Home is told) and opens the Home for one tap. (The invitation calls are answered by the test)
results.note: a dead link: can't be opened; 'Ruth invited you to Seed Bible' with her note; Continue asks for the terms; signed in, 'Welcome' and Add took the invitation and opened the Home to add Ruth
